data.note: the validation split carries the evaluation transform, not the training augmentation; the test split is the full published 10,000 images and is scored once per model

audit.method: content hashing for exact matches; nearest neighbour in L2 over pixels scaled to [0, 1] for near matches, run once against the training images and once against their mirror images
audit.limits: this covers identical and mirrored images only. A duplicate that has been cropped, rescaled or recompressed will not be found by it, and a published analysis using a richer search reports a higher figure, so what is measured here is a lower bound

reference_run.hardware: NVIDIA MX330, per the original README
reference_run.note: the original script seeded only the two split generators, so its exact figure was not reproducible even on its own machine; this reproduction seeds everything and runs on different hardware and a different torch build
